pages.text: Flesh parts grafted onto the surface decide what an organism $(o)does$(). Place them against its flesh.$(br2)$(item)Tap$(): use an empty container on it to draw from the store.$(br)$(item)Maw$(): swallows what you pour into it, and sucks from a jug or another organism's Tap that faces it.

pages.title: Leech Tendril
pages.text: Drains the organism's own aspect from creatures within a few blocks, a dram at a time. This is how farms work.$(br2)A Density organism in a pen of leashed cows: a field of floating cows, tethered, slowly being emptied. Exactly right.
